notes:
Balloons are read whole.

A speech balloon's lettering comes to the app as separate lines, and read-along was stopping between them — so a sentence would break a word or two before the end and start again. "Your sword isn't reaching… you." Now a balloon is spoken as the sentence it was lettered as.

• Short words no longer break a sentence. Whether a word happened to have a tall letter in it was deciding where the voice paused.
• Long balloons hold together to the end. The longer the sentence ran, the more likely its last words came adrift.

Best noticed on Japanese page manga, where balloons carry the most lines.
